songbird.purpose: Gaia can browse Tor herself. Songbird flies outbound through onion pores. She can reach other .onion services. The tower atomic relay.

biology: Onion pores in cell membranes = channel proteins that selectively allow molecules through. Each pore has a specific shape (port) that only certain molecules (protocols) fit through. Tor onion layers = lipid bilayer of the membrane. The spirochete corkscrews through the pores.
